_comment: Real example, instantiated over a critical-flow domain (a critical-flow domain): 32 rules mapped to the property hierarchy. Copy to config/property-hierarchy-map.json if your project uses a similar hierarchy.

A11Y-001.why: controls with a localized description and a sensible focus order during payment

ARCH-001.why: domain/data with no Android or eventing keeps the core testable and leak-free

ARCH-002.why: an event that decides money is not lost or duplicated outside the global bus

ARCH-003.why: paired register/unregister avoids leaks and zombie states after retries

ARCH-004.why: files under 500 lines can be reviewed and reasoned about

ARCH-005.why: a process-wide default overwritten by an SDK breaks TLS for everyone

ARCH-006.why: knowledge duplication means two implementations silently diverging

CHG-001.why: new code with style, old code with a ticket: the change is traceable

CHG-002.why: a finding closes against trunk, not against a branch

CHG-003.why: SDK defect reported with evidence; patch tagged with a removal condition

CHG-004.why: binary allowlist and no dev switches left on in release

CONC-001.why: no GlobalScope on terminal paths: work is cancelled and retried with an owner

CONC-002.why: RMW inside the transform: persisted state never loses a concurrent write

CONC-003.why: memory barrier and CAS on callback fields: state is never read stale

CONC-004.why: its own deadline and signal, not polling: the flow ends even if the SDK never responds

KS-001.why: the combinator that names the intent reads at a glance; it is readability, not money

KS-002.why: fewer lines with more resolutions protects the reviewer's reading

KS-003.why: a business condition with a single source avoids two diverging truths

LOG-001.why: everything through the facade: the log is complete and filterable

LOG-002.why: no full payload and outcome logged at Info: no payment data leaks

LOG-003.why: sensitive data typed and masked by declaration

LOG-004.why: no device capture anywhere in the tree

MONEY-001.why: pure transformations in their own file: every money row is verifiable

MONEY-002.why: minorUnits with no locale: the amount charged is the amount calculated

MONEY-003.why: stable idempotency key per sale notification

MONEY-004.why: finite retry by cause avoids charging twice or never

MONEY-005.why: raw vendor code kept apart from synthetic code: the outcome can be reconstructed

MONEY-006.why: green only on confirmed delivery: the shown state is the real state

TEST-001.why: additive wire contract frozen by a golden test

TEST-002.why: the guard reads the source and carries a negative control: the guarantee is real

TEST-003.why: no vocabulary that exists only in tests: prod and test speak the same language
